basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old software developer based in Portland, Oregon. I have a keen interest in psychedelics and their potential for personal growth, which has led me to explore subreddits like psilocybin and GeneticCounseling. When I'm not coding or lurking on Reddit, I enjoy hiking in the Pacific Northwest and binging on anime, particularly Devilman Crybaby. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and work as a full-stack developer. My interest in psychedelics is more self-taught, stemming from reading various articles and engaging with communities online. I also have a growing curiosity about genetics and how it relates to mental health.
